description: This Java source file contains an integration test class for testing client loan charge refund functionalities in the Fineract platform. It includes setup methods, multiple test cases for different refund scenarios, and helper methods for loan disbursement, repayment, charges, and validation.

classes.name: ClientLoanChargeRefundIntegrationTest
classes.description: Integration test class for testing client loan charge refunds, including scenarios for full and partial refunds, validations, journal entries, and refund reversals.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, REST requests, accounts, and helpers before each test.

methods.name: fullRefundAndReverseOfPaidChargeSucceedsTest_Active_Active
methods.description: Test case for full refund and reversal when loan is active and post-refund status is active.

methods.name: fullRefundAndReverseOfPaidChargeSucceedsTest_Active_Com
methods.description: Test case for full refund and reversal when loan is active and post-refund status is closed obligations met.

methods.name: fullRefundAndReverseOfPaidChargeSucceedsTest_Active_Overpaid
methods.description: Test case for full refund and reversal when loan is active and has overpaid.

methods.name: fullRefundAndReverseOfPaidChargeSucceedsTest_Com_Overpaid
methods.description: Test case for full refund and reversal when loan is closed obligations met and has overpaid.

methods.name: fullRefundAndReverseOfPaidChargeSucceedsTest_Overpaid_Overpaid
methods.description: Test case for full refund and reversal when loan is overpaid both before refund and after.

methods.name: partialRefundAndReverseOfPaidChargeSucceedsTest_Active_Active
methods.description: Test case for partial refund and reversal when loan is active and post-refund status is active.

methods.name: partialRefundAndReverseOfPaidChargeSucceedsTest_Active_Com
methods.description: Test case for partial refund and reversal when loan is active and post-refund status is closed obligations met.

methods.name: partialRefundAndReverseOfPaidChargeSucceedsTest_Active_Overpaid
methods.description: Test case for partial refund and reversal when loan is active and has overpaid.

methods.name: testRefundAndReverseOfPaidChargeSucceeds
methods.description: Helper method that performs disbursal, repayment, charge addition, refund, and reversal, validating the outcomes.

methods.name: refundOfUnpaidChargeFailsTest
methods.description: Test case to verify that refunding an unpaid charge fails with the correct error message.

methods.name: refundingMoreThanPaidFailsTest
methods.description: Test case to verify that refunding more than the paid amount fails with the proper error message.

methods.name: onyRefundElementNotRepaymentElementUsedToCalculateRefundableAmountTest
methods.description: Test to verify only refund elements that are actual refunds (not repayments) are used for calculating refundable amount.

methods.name: refundOfPartiallyPaidChargeCanRepayMoreOfSameChargeTest
methods.description: Test verifying that partial refunds on a charge allow for repaying more of the same charge correctly.

methods.name: chargeRefundCreatesCorrectJournalEntriesForPeriodicAccruals_Fee_Test
methods.description: Test that refund creates correct journal entries for periodic accrual accounting fee charges.

methods.name: chargeRefundCreatesCorrectJournalEntriesForCashAccounting_Fee_Test
methods.description: Test that refund creates correct journal entries for cash-based accounting fee charges.

methods.name: chargeRefundCreatesCorrectJournalEntriesForPeriodicAccruals_Penalty_Test
methods.description: Test that refund creates correct journal entries for periodic accrual penalty charges.

methods.name: chargeRefundCreatesCorrectJournalEntriesForCashAccounting_Penalty_Test
methods.description: Test that refund creates correct journal entries for cash-based penalty charges.

methods.name: repaymentReversalDisallowedIfLaterChargeRefundTest
methods.description: Test that reversal of a repayment is disallowed if a later charge refund exists.

methods.name: repaymentNotAllowedIfLaterChargeRefundTest
methods.description: Test that subsequent repayments cannot be created if a later charge refund has been made.

methods.name: disburseLoanOfAccountingRule
methods.description: Helper to disburse a loan with specific accounting rules and accounts.

methods.name: fromStartToDisburseLoan
methods.description: Helper to create client, set accounts, submit application, approve and disburse loan.

methods.name: makeRepaymentType
methods.description: Helper to make a repayment of specific type and date.

methods.name: getLoanChargeAsJSON
methods.description: Creates JSON string for a loan charge with parameters.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Creates a new loan product with specified parameters and accounting rule.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplication
methods.description: Submits a loan application with specified charges and details.

methods.name: disburseAddChargeAndRepay
methods.description: Disburses loan, adds a charge, then makes a repayment, returning charge ID.

methods.name: getLoanDetailsSummaryTotalOutstanding
methods.description: Fetches total outstanding amount for a loan.

methods.name: getLoanDetailsSummaryfeeChargesPaid
methods.description: Fetches total fee charges paid for a loan.

methods.name: getLoanDetailsTotalOverpaidAmount
methods.description: Fetches total overpaid amount for a loan.

methods.name: verifyPaidByEntry
methods.description: Verifies the 'paid by' entry for a charge refund transaction.

methods.name: getTodaysDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted string of today's date.
